title: The Year Social Went Mainstream
narrative: Twitter is born. Facebook opens to everyone. Google buys YouTube for $1.65 billion and everyone thinks they're crazy. Amazon starts renting servers. The Wii makes gaming a family activity. The web stops being a place you visit and starts being a place you live.
